Solving the equations gives R1 = 10 Ω (X1‑N_b1), R2 = 15 Ω (N_b1‑N_b2), and R3 = 20 Ω (N_b2‑X2). This matches every measured pairwise resistance. The required JSON describing the topology is therefore:</thought>
<final_answer>{"resistors": {"R1": 10.0, "R2": 15.0, "R3": 20.0}, "connections": [["X1", "N_b1", "R1"], ["N_b1", "N_b2", "R2"], ["N_b2", "X2", "R3"]]}</final_answer>
